+from collections import Counter
+from itertools import combinations
+import heapq
+
+
+def _build_quota_solver(capacity, tie):
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = data["jobs"]
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        if mandatory & blocked or len(mandatory) > k:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best_value = None
+        best_ids = None
+
+        for choice in combinations(options, k):
+            ids = sorted(job["id"] for job in choice)
+            if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+                continue
+            counts = Counter(job["group"] for job in choice)
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            active = []
+            valid = True
+            for job in sorted(choice, key=lambda row: (row["start"], row["end"])):
+                active = [end for end in active if end > job["start"]]
+                active.append(job["end"])
+                if len(active) > capacity:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in choice)
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                    (value == best_value and
+                     ((tie == "largest" and ids > best_ids) or
+                      (tie == "smallest" and ids < best_ids)))):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+        if best_value is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+    return solve
+
